question: Does equal-parameter front versus back Q/V-LoRA placement modify the clean-error benefit of fixed RandAugment in this common training recipe?
endpoint: Final fixed epoch only. No best epoch, class selection, seed/LR search or final-test reading.

resource_decision.rule: 30 epochs if 1.25 times dummy-measured compute+pacing estimate <=7200 seconds; otherwise 10 if feasible, else stop.
resource_decision.pre_result_revision_reason: 370 updates at 10 epochs may undertrain a random 37-class head. Use the draft maximum30 uniformly if actual local resource cost permits; no task outcome has been inspected.

architecture.name: torchvision vit_b_16
architecture.patch_tokenization: 224x224 RGB, patch16 stride16 ->196 patches plus one class token; same learned position embedding; no text tokenizer.
architecture.LoRA: Q and V only, r4, alpha/r1, A~N(0,.01^2) shared by slot, B0; K correction identically zero.
architecture.frozen: All base projection/bias, patch embedding, positional/class token, LayerNorm and all other original parameters.

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.schedule: 10% integer-floor linear warmup then cosine by logical update, as locked common.py.
optimizer.sensitivity_scope: A common recipe interaction; equal LR is not proof of equal optimization difficulty or layout-optimal performance. No selective LR repair or extension after seeing the sign.

augmentation.weak: PIL RRC scale[.8,1] ratio[.9,1.1],224 bilinear antialias; independent HFlip .5.
augmentation.ra: Same weak image then torchvision full14-operation RandAugment, N2 M9/31, bilinear, fill[124,116,104].
augmentation.RNG: Separate SHA256 keyed CPU RNG for weak and RA by source ID/epoch/seed, source-order key independent of model RNG.
augmentation.pairing: Every epoch ordered RGB, normalized FP32 input tensor and source-ID order SHA must match across layouts within each augmentation.

data.source: Oxford-IIIT Pet fixed mirror revision003aeb4bc80d584ef307dc24e8b38d26cf9f9e43, original trainval only.
data.reuse: Each training source once per epoch; same source exposure and logical updates in every cell, no repeated/resampled sources to fill batches.
data.evaluation: Deterministic shorter-edge256 bilinear antialias, center crop224, ImageNet normalization; argmax takes first maximum, natural-log NLL from FP32 logits in float64.
data.label_preservation: Original annotated breed identity is the target; geometry/visual QA supports visibility only. Photometric or crop loss of breed cues can remain; no causal invariance proof.
data.independence: Source photograph after conservative known duplicate removal. Unknown animal identity and ImageNet overlap remain unverified.
data.reserved_confirmation: 592 candidate IDs remain sealed: no reserved members requested by name, extracted, stored, decoded, scored or used for training/selection. Public ZIP range buffers include a discarded header margin; see data/range-transfer-scope.json rather than claiming literal transport-byte exclusion.
data.license: Official current CC BY-SA4.0, legacy research/original-site notice preserved. Local research only, attribution/modification notes; no redistribution.

primary_metric: source-photo micro classification error on clean development images

bootstrap.algorithm: Pair the four cell errors by source ID; independently resample with replacement inside each of37 observed breeds, preserving original breed counts; sum sampled d_i /total N.
bootstrap.unit: source photograph after all confirmed/uncertain duplicate clusters removed
bootstrap.scope: Fixed-model conditional photo-sampling sensitivity only; not training variability, animal-level independence, population coverage or confirmatory inference.

gate_rationale: One percentage point is the pre-existing proposal engineering investment scale (~6 net error-count units out of592); it is not significance, power, equivalence or a novelty criterion. No CI lower-bound condition is added.

decision.I_below_gate: Retain failure of this common-recipe development gate. No extra seeds to rescue sign, no test opening. Inspect optimization sufficiency honestly; cannot reject all possible position x augmentation effects.
decision.I_above_gate: Potential development signal only; requires predeclared paired seeds, fair optimization sensitivity and stronger reference arms before an original contribution claim.
decision.both_RA_gaps_negative: At most moderation of RA harm, not unlocked enhancement benefit.
decision.measurement_failure: Nonfinite gradients/loss, OOM, missing/frozen/wrong parameters, unequal pixels, budget stop or incomplete endpoints -> incomplete/invalid measurement, not scientific negative.
decision.underfitting: Report CE and late trajectory without post-hoc numeric convergence threshold. Fixed budget is not a convergence guarantee; do not extend only a weak cell.

claim_boundary: No SOTA/full-FT superiority, unique mechanism, causal effect identification, publication or teacher-approval guarantee.

resources.STOP.request: Create file in run root for graceful stop after logical update.
